paragraph.value: During the 1980s, as the Mandarin-speaking immigrant community in Los Angeles grew rapidly, the church recognized the need to share the gospel and provide a spiritual home for these new immigrants. In response, MPCBC established its Mandarin Ministry, holding its first Mandarin worship service in 1988.

mpcbc_zh_hant.value: 但從八十年代起，教會看到講國語的新移民人數在洛杉磯迅速增長，考慮到新移民對基督福音的需要。於是，教會決定開展國語事工，為新移民群體預備一個屬靈的家，於1988年開始了國語崇拜。

editor_settings.title: During the 1980s, as the Mandarin-speaking immig

paragraph.value: In 1991, MPCBC expanded its ministry by introducing an English worship service. Since then, the church has continued to worship in three languages, serving different language communities while remaining united as one church in Christ.

mpcbc_zh_hant.value: 之後，在1991年教會又增設了英語的崇拜，直到如今，教會一直保持有三種語言的崇拜。

paragraph.value: Through worship, fellowship, discipleship, ministry, and evangelism, we seek to know God, and make His name known.

mpcbc_zh_hant.value: 我們藉著敬拜、團契、門徒訓練、事奉、傳福音來認識和榮耀神。

paragraph.value: We believe in Jesus, God’s only Son, who died on a cross for our sins, was raised to life, and will one day return. We believe in the Trinity: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. We teach the Bible, believing that it is from God, entirely true, and relevant to our present age.

editor_settings.title: We believe in Jesus, God’s only Son, who died on

paragraph.value: God is the Creator and Ruler of the universe. He exists eternally as three persons: the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit. These three are equal and are one God.

mpcbc_zh_hant.value: 神是宇宙的創造者與主宰，祂以三位一体永遠存在:聖父、聖子、聖靈。三位同等為一神。

editor_settings.title: God is the Creator and Ruler of the universe. He

paragraph.value: Jesus Christ is the Son of God and is equal with the Father. Jesus lived a sinless life on earth and offered Himself as the perfect sacrifice, dying on the cross for all humanity. He rose from the dead after three days, demonstrating His power over sin and death. He ascended to heavenly glory and will return to earth as King of kings and Lord of lords.

mpcbc_zh_hant.value: 耶穌基督是神的兒子，與父同等。耶穌曾在地上無罪活過人生，並將自己獻上成為最完美的祭，為所有的人類死在十字架上。三天後從死裡復活，彰顯祂勝過罪與死的權能。祂升到天上的榮耀，有一天要回到地上來作萬王之王、萬主之主。

editor_settings.title: Jesus Christ is the Son of God and is equal with

paragraph.value: Matthew 1:22-23; Isaiah 9:6; John 1:1-5, 14:10-30; Hebrews 4:14,15; 1 Corinthians 15:3-4; Romans 1:3-4; Acts 1:9-11; 1 Timothy 6:14; Titus 2:13

The Holy Spirit is equal with the Father and the Son. He is present in the world to help people know Christ, and He lives in every Christian from the moment of salvation. He gives believers power for daily living, understanding of spiritual truth and guidance for the way ahead. He gives spiritual gifts to every believer. As Christians, we seek daily to live under the Holy Spirit’s direction.

mpcbc_zh_hant.value: 聖靈與聖父聖子同等。祂臨在世上為要幫助人認識基督。並且在人得救那一刻，祂便住在每一個基督徒裡面。祂供應每個基督徒每天生活的能力，對於屬靈真理的理解力，以及前行的引導。祂賞賜屬靈恩賜給每個得救的信徒。作為基督徒，我們每天尋求過一個聖靈管理的生活。

editor_settings.title: The Holy Spirit is equal with the Father and the

paragraph.value: 2 Corinthians 3:17; John 16:7-13, 14:16-17; Acts 1:8; 1 Corinthians 2:12; 3:16 Ephesians 1:13,5:18; Galatians 5:25
The Bible is God’s Word to us, written by people under the supernatural guidance of the Holy Spirit. It is the highest authority for Christian faith and life.

mpcbc_zh_hant.value: 聖經是神給我們的話，是藉著聖靈超然的引導，由人寫成。是基督徒信仰與生活的最高準則。

editor_settings.title: The Bible is God’s Word to us, written by people

paragraph.value: Human beings were created in God’s spiritual image, reflecting His character. Humanity is the pinnacle of God’s creation. Although every person has the potential for good, our sinful attitudes separate us from God and bring many problems into our lives.

mpcbc_zh_hant.value: 人類是照神屬靈的形象所造，本有神的屬性。人是神創造的極致。雖然人本有善的潛能，我們每個人卻都因著罪的態度與神隔絕，而使得生命陷入種種問題。

editor_settings.title: Human beings were created in God’s spiritual ima

paragraph.value: Salvation is God’s free gift, which we must receive. We can never atone for our sins through good works or self-improvement. Only through Jesus Christ and God’s forgiveness can we be delivered from the penalty of sin. We are saved when we turn in faith to Jesus from a self-centred life lived in our own strength. Eternal life begins when we receive the life of Jesus Christ by faith.

mpcbc_zh_hant.value: 救恩是神給我們白白的禮物，但需要我們去接受。我們永遠無法靠著善行與自我改善來贖我們的罪。惟有靠著耶穌基督，蒙神赦免，才能從罪的刑罰得贖。當我們從以自我為中心、靠自己的生命，憑信心轉向耶穌時，我們便得救。永遠的生命開始於我們憑信心接受耶穌基督的生命那一刻。

editor_settings.title: Salvation is God’s free gift, which we must rece

paragraph.value: Because God gives us eternal life through Jesus Christ, true believers have eternal assurance of salvation. Salvation comes through God’s power and grace, not through a Christian’s own efforts. His preserving power and grace give us this lasting assurance. Believers also have a responsibility to continue trusting God and living in His care.

mpcbc_zh_hant.value: 由於神通過耶穌基督賜給我們永遠的生命，真信徒有永遠的得救保障。救贖是藉著神的權能與恩典，不是憑基督徒自己的努力。神保守的權能與恩典使我們有這永遠的保障。但信徒也有責任不斷信靠神，活在神的保守之中。

editor_settings.title: Because God gives us eternal life through Jesus

paragraph.value: John 10:29; 2 Timothy 1:12; Hebrews 7:25, 10:10,14; 1 Peter 1:3-5; Hebrews 6:4-8; Hebrews 10:26-27; John 15:6

People were created to exist forever. We will either be eternally separated from God because of sin, or live eternally with Him through forgiveness and salvation. Eternal separation from God is hell; eternal life is being with God forever.

mpcbc_zh_hant.value: 人被創造要存到永遠。我們或要因著罪與神永遠隔離，或是因著赦免與救恩與神永遠同在。與神永遠隔離便是地獄，與神永遠同在便是永遠的生命。

paragraph.value: Pastor Caleb Cheung is from Hong Kong. He studied theology at Fuller Theological Seminary, then pursued doctoral studies in theology and philosophy of religion at Claremont Graduate University. He stayed on to serve and shepherd MPCBC, where he is now Senior Pastor.

mpcbc_zh_hant.value: 張健庭牧師來自香港，多年前蒙召在福樂神學院（Fuller Theological Seminary）念神學，繼在克萊蒙研究大學（Claremont Graduate University）進修博士課程專修神學及宗教哲學，後留在本教會事奉與牧養，現任本教會主任牧師。

paragraph.value: Connect Ministry is the English-language congregation of Monterey Park Chinese Baptist Church. We are a multigenerational church family growing together through worship, biblical teaching, fellowship, and service.

mpcbc_zh_hant.value: Connect Ministry（英語堂）是慕道園華人浸信會的英語會眾。我們是一個跨越世代的教會家庭，透過敬拜、聖經教導、團契和服事一同成長。

editor_settings.title: Connect Ministry is the English-language congreg

paragraph.value: We seek to connect to our wonderful Lord Jesus through inspiring worship and the preaching of His Word, the Bible. We also seek to connect with each other through various Small Groups and Fellowships. Connect Ministry is a diverse group of varying ages, ethnicities, and backgrounds. We care about your forgiveness and restoration, and about your kids and youth.

mpcbc_zh_hant.value: 我們盼望透過激勵人心的敬拜和神話語——聖經——的宣講，與我們奇妙的主耶穌連結；也透過各小組和團契彼此連結。Connect Ministry 由不同年齡、族裔和背景的人組成。我們關心您能得著赦免與恢復，也關心您的孩子和青少年。

paragraph.value: Whether you are exploring Christianity, returning to church, or looking for a church family, we invite you to come as you are. Our desire is to help people grow in faith, build meaningful relationships, and use their gifts to serve God and others.

mpcbc_zh_hant.value: 無論您正在認識基督信仰、重回教會，或是在尋找一個教會家庭，我們都邀請您以真實的自己前來。我們盼望幫助人在信心中成長、建立有意義的關係，並運用恩賜服事神和他人。
